test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Identify the correct statement/s regarding budgetary deficit?

i. Deficit acts as a flow that adds to the stock of the debt.

ii. Deficit acts as stock, which is independent of debt.

iii. Deficit acts as a burden on the future generation.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only i and iii**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Budgetary deficit:-**

 
 
• It refers to a situation where the government spends more money than it earns through revenue collection.
 
• Deficit adds to the stock of debt as the government borrows money to finance the deficit.
